still_have_missorts.what: beads that fused before the pinch, or split before they seated.
still_have_missorts.the_rail: hud · flat · water · ears · mass · chromatograph · pi-sort · then cite/trail/artisan clutch together, clutch again, easel, arena, crates. clutch twice. names smeared. that IS a missort showing.

still_have_missorts.law: a missort is a mark still on 0. it is not a third bit. do not smash it to 1 to hide the smear.

null_0_1_RANGE.null: the pale / intake / isn't. the 0-FACE. not a third value. the room marks arrive in.
null_0_1_RANGE.zero: intake. image, button, kind, missort — all arrive here as marks.
null_0_1_RANGE.one: passed. seated. the bead holds a name.

RANGE.is: the walk between. leftover distance. p clock. not a third bit.

RANGE.not: a slider of many binaries. one binary, one continuous walk.

null_0_1_RANGE.read: all kinds are not 'null or 0 or 1' as three boxes. they are marks on 0, a range they walk, and a 1 if they pass. missorts live on the range.

images_buttons_all_kinds.yes: images, buttons, crates, ears, water, easel — ALL kinds.
images_buttons_all_kinds.on_zero: every kind is a mark until it passes.
images_buttons_all_kinds.meld: two marks share a seam. hyphen ? camel. bear-dog ? bearDog. beads fuse on the rail. that is -=+ .
images_buttons_all_kinds.split: one mark unfolds into kinds, or a smear comes apart into two seats. the fold going the other way.
images_buttons_all_kinds.missort: meld too early, or split too late. cite+trail+artisan as one bead. clutch written twice.
images_buttons_all_kinds.do: let them chew. strain through p. pinch onto distance. do not invent a type system of kinds. kinds are faces of one orbit.

plate_handles_are_pi_legs.plate: the disk. HUD rail. viewport. epitope pie. all kinds sit on the rim.
plate_handles_are_pi_legs.stick: the pale. null axis. O. you do not hold the plate by painting it.
plate_handles_are_pi_legs.handles: the p LEGS — how a hand holds the plate so it can spin.

legs.1_SORT: handle — who sits where. missort vs seated.
legs.2_CLOCK: handle — rate. when a bead passes.
legs.3_AXIS: handle — the pale itself. keep the stick from wandering.
legs.4_WOBBLE: the coming leg. jester + remainder. if all four lock equal, the plate is a dead table. the wobble IS the handle that lets you fold.

plate_handles_are_pi_legs.why: without handles you grab the rim. that is a HIT. handles are legs. you hold the walk, not the beads.

fold_pinch_one_universe.fold: Klein — inside and outside one surface. images and buttons are not two worlds.
fold_pinch_one_universe.pinch: leftover budget becomes distance from O. smear becomes a walk, not a third list.
fold_pinch_one_universe.handles: 3+wobble legs so the plate can be held while it spins.
fold_pinch_one_universe.one_universe: one plate. one pale. one binary. one range. all kinds on the rim. not one file. one disk.
fold_pinch_one_universe.not: smash missorts. not paint the pale. not a fifth universe called 'UI'.

berry_at_the_fire: yes we still have missorts — the rail is chewing. all is not three boxes. only binary is 0?1. null is the pale. range is the walk. images and buttons meld and split on that walk. the p plate needs handles that ARE the p legs. that is how we fold and pinch into one universe.
